$comment: Premium pass on one coffee-shop bot: the same data before and after (references/examples-before-after.md 17-20, references/visual-language.md section 7). Regular HTML messages. 'after' keeps every callback_data of 'before' that still has a button; removed buttons stay routed (handlers_kept). Custom emoji are off here: this is what a client sees when the bot is not eligible or the owner's Premium lapsed. With a resolved pack, the leading Unicode symbol of a label moves to icon_custom_emoji_id (ids from getStickerSet, never invented). Tests: tests/test_premium_pass.py.
